source.attribution: Corporations Canada / Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (OGL)

parsing.notes: 8 CSVs: active/inactive x CBCA/non-CBCA x EN/FR. Ingest active+inactive (EN), key on Corporation number. UTF-8 BOM. Resolve current resource URLs from the open.canada.ca dataset (CloudFront hosts). Federal corporations ONLY.

mapping_rules.vat_id: Not available (GST/HST = BN + RT program account).
mapping_rules.legal_name: Use Corporate name - form 1 (fall back to form 2).
mapping_rules.incorporation_date: Approximate from Anniversary date (exact via API).
mapping_rules.registered_address: Compose Street + Street 2 + City/town + Province + Postal code + Country.

fixture_requirements: active CBCA corporation with BN + full address (e.g. corp # 8660115)

live_test_plan.smoke: Stream first 1000 rows of the active CBCA CSV; assert 17 columns + Corporation number.
live_test_plan.full: Periodic: download active + inactive (EN) CSVs, stream to NDJSON keyed on Corporation number; add provincial sources for full coverage.

blockers: Covers federally-incorporated corporations only — provincial companies need provincial registries.
No NAICS / financials in this dataset; director names only via the API.
